balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.description: Moderate HP, offenses, defenses and Speed; the reference profile.

brute.name: Brute
brute.description: High HP and Strength, slow cadence and weaker magical protection.

armored.name: Armored
armored.description: High physical durability with lower magical protection.

warded.name: Warded
warded.description: High magical protection with lower physical Defense.

swift.name: Swift
swift.description: Frequent, accurate attacks with limited durability.

evasive.name: Evasive
evasive.description: Difficult to hit but fragile when attacks connect.

caster.name: Caster
caster.description: High spell power and MP with low physical durability.

hybrid.name: Hybrid
hybrid.description: Developed physical and magical offenses with MP for mixed attacks.

support.name: Support
support.description: Strong healing and support capacity with low direct offense.

lightweight.name: Lightweight
lightweight.description: Low individual durability and damage, suited to larger groups; Speed is not automatically exceptional.

standard_attacks.name: Standard Attacks
standard_attacks.description: Use affordable attacks, with a free fallback when MP is exhausted.

magical_offense.name: Magical Offense
magical_offense.description: Favor damaging spells while maintaining a free fallback.

physical_magical_alternation.name: Physical/Magical Alternation
physical_magical_alternation.description: Alternate physical and magical attacks; fall back when MP runs out.

telegraphed_windup.name: Telegraphed Windup
telegraphed_windup.description: Announce a target, prepare a powerful attack and then recover.

ally_healing.name: Ally Healing
ally_healing.description: Spend actions and MP healing injured allies.

ally_buffing.name: Ally Buffing
ally_buffing.description: Improve allies through authored offensive, defensive or ATB buffs.

low_hp_aggression.name: Low-HP Aggression
low_hp_aggression.description: Become more aggressive below a visible HP threshold.

wounded_targeting.name: Wounded Targeting
wounded_targeting.description: Favor the living character with the lowest HP percentage.

category_counter.name: Category Counter
category_counter.description: Telegraph retaliation against a selected attack category.

defensive_stances.name: Defensive Stances
defensive_stances.description: Alternate physical and magical defensive strengths.

self_healing.name: Self Healing
self_healing.description: Restore personal HP during battle to reward concentrated burst damage.

mp_siphon.name: MP Siphon
mp_siphon.description: Drain party MP to replenish the enemy supply.

ally_interception.name: Ally Interception
ally_interception.description: Intercept a limited number of attacks against selected allies.

atb_disruption.name: ATB Disruption
atb_disruption.description: Occasionally push back a target gauge with bounded disruption.

soldier.name: Soldier
soldier.description: Dependable ordinary attacker supporting specialized allies.

brute.name: Brute
brute.description: Heavy physical pressure separated by slow turns.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.description: Absorb physical punishment; encourage magical attacks or other target priorities.

warder.name: Warder
warder.description: Resist magical damage while presenting a physical vulnerability.

duelist.name: Duelist
duelist.description: Apply frequent reliable attacks; removing it reduces enemy action pressure.

skirmisher.name: Skirmisher
skirmisher.description: Reward accurate attacks against a fragile evasive target.

arcanist.name: Arcanist
arcanist.description: Deliver dangerous spells from a fragile body.

battlemage.name: Battlemage
battlemage.description: Challenge reliance on only one defensive strength.

windup_attacker.name: Windup Attacker
windup_attacker.description: Give a clear opportunity to guard or defeat the enemy before its major attack.

mender.name: Mender
mender.description: Undo damage to allies and change target priority.

captain.name: Captain
captain.description: Multiply the threat posed by accompanying enemies.

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.description: Punish leaving several wounded enemies active.

opportunist.name: Opportunist
opportunist.description: Pressure vulnerable characters and timely recovery.

counterfighter.name: Counterfighter
counterfighter.description: Reward changing attack type or target when a counter is prepared.

stancechanger.name: Stancechanger
stancechanger.description: Reward adjusting damage type as defensive strengths change.

swarmer.name: Swarmer
swarmer.description: Create collective ATB pressure through numbers, with low individual HP and damage.

regenerator.name: Regenerator
regenerator.description: Sustain itself through recovery and reward concentrated burst damage.

siphoner.name: Siphoner
siphoner.description: Threaten casting endurance even when direct HP damage is modest.

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.description: Protect selected allies through limited interception.

disruptor.name: Disruptor
disruptor.description: Delay important attacks or recovery through occasional ATB disruption.

bat.notes: A small Evasion adjustment awaits numerical tuning. The live Bat retains its existing authored stats and actions.

ridgeback_tusker.notes: Brute describes its growth bias; Lowered Tusks and Bankbreaker Charge define its behavior. Live quest tuning is preserved.
